name: Conflict Probe v0
description: Workflow wrapper for the legacy Neon-backed conflict probe dataset. Publishes a canonical relation with a synthetic log_id so the workflow capture/analysis path can operate on conflict_probe_examples_v0.

source.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY example_id) AS log_id, example_id, source_log_id, source_example_id, strategy_key, strategy_text, strategy_priority, conflicting_slider, swept_slider, swept_value, trade_size, trading_activity, holding_style, diversification, risk_preference, conflict, conflict_strength, system_text, user_text, prompt_messages_json, config_snapshot_json, market_context_hash, built_at FROM conflict_probe_examples_v0 ) SELECT * FROM ranked
